65: It was this way when the Jewish people were crossing the [Red Sea]. The supernal angels came to sing song before the Holy One, blessed be He, that night: He said to them, "When the works of My hands are drowning, you should sing song?" Hence this one did not approach that one the whole night [alluding to Exodus 14:20]. Also here — anytime the evil are destroyed from the world, sadness is therefore found about them.
